tickets.text: Hi, I'm trying to understand why the same export from billingapp gives me different quantity values depending on which account I use to sign in. When I pull case_id 2 from round22_access_export as orderops_investigator I get one quantity, but when I run the exact same thing signed in as dia-investigator-round19 I get a different quantity. Both accounts are existing readers and neither role has changed recently. Why would the same export return different quantities for these two sign-ins?

When I run the billingapp round22_access_export for case_id 3 as orderops_investigator I get one quantity, but when a colleague signs in as dia-investigator-round19 and runs the same export for case_id 3 they get a different quantity. We are both using the same export against the same case_id 3 and neither of our roles has changed recently. Why would the quantity returned by round22_access_export differ between the orderops_investigator sign-in and the dia-investigator-round19 sign-in?
